subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add a producer-owned structured progress metrics contract to plugin hook events, and which runtime source owns step totals, percent, ETA, and terminal metrics across embedded, CLI, and Codex-facing paths?
rationale: The missing fields are source-reproducible, but the correct semantics are a public Plugin SDK/API decision that automation should not invent from tool-call counts alone.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover the main hook producers with focused tests.

options.title: Keep hooks unchanged
options.body: Leave plugins to derive progress from existing lifecycle, text progress, and tool events, accepting text-only live cards until a stronger source exists.

options.title: Design a separate progress event
options.body: Create a dedicated progress event or agent-event projection instead of attaching percentages to tool and terminal hooks.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover the main hook producers with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history ties vincentkoc to the closest public hook payload contract work and current hook runtime ownership trail.
